contract: Shared and compact gather forecasts include batch, column-directory/key and vector descriptors. The complete output extent is admitted before construction. Descriptor admission is independently pinned through construction/reentrant disposal, then partitioned into container-only owners. Existing compaction metadata provenance drops obsolete batch/directory/vector containers while preserving reachable vectors and payload aliases. Compact selection compares complete retained shared-versus-compact costs and independently enforces construction overlap headroom.

validation.negativeControl: The empty-gather container-boundary test fails against published b7f35aa because it allocates below the required 256-byte batch/directory extent; restored implementation passes.
cases: 0/1/32/256-column fixtures with zero or repeated selected rows; exact capacity and one byte below before backing construction
Independent actual output property/key counts match descriptor forecasts
Shared and compact ownership transfer, repeated compaction and zero final charge
Parent-stage disposal inside a backing allocator keeps descriptor admission live until construction settles
Existing compact scalar/packed matrix across zero/one/two dictionary indirections
512-iteration concat/selection tests preserve their original 4 KiB/16 KiB retained-memory ceilings after registering descriptor provenance
Numeric-dictionary headroom test now includes descriptor costs in the copy-versus-view boundary; exact and one-byte-below remain covered
validation.parquetFixtureUpdate: The complete retained-cost policy now chooses compact output by default for the nine-row fixture. Local and native R2 fixtures first verify that default, then constrain the consumer to one byte below detached overlap to preserve explicit shared-fallback coverage through scanner shutdown. Four local direct/general scanner cases and all native R2 variants pass within the 95-test Worker suite.

release.checks: build, types, clean package consumers, compatibility, changeset, deterministic fixtures, large files, lint and unchanged coverage thresholds passed

scope: Real DuckDB-generated local Parquet; all output rows checked; no cloud-throughput, speedup or total-runtime-memory claim. Modeled peaks include previously untracked containers.
remaining: Descriptor coverage in other constructors, planning and temporary copy views, codec workspace and runtime bookkeeping/headroom
